atoms.sound: What is the value of 2 ex when ex equals 2?

atoms.a: What is the value of <mat>x^2</mat> when <mat>x=2</mat>?
atoms.sound: What is the value of x squared when ex equals 2?

feedback.finish: When x=2, these expressions are equal. We can test whether they are equivalent by using a different value for 𝘹.

atoms.sound: What is the value of 2 ex when ex equals 3?

atoms.a: What is the value of <mat>x^2</mat> when <mat>x=3</mat>?
atoms.sound: What is the value of x squared when ex equals 3?

feedback.finish: When x=3, these expressions are no longer equal, meaning they are not equivalent. Equivalent expressions are equal for all values.
